import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int h = scanner.nextInt();
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        String binaryStr = Integer.toBinaryString(n - 1);
        binaryStr = "0".repeat(h - binaryStr.length()) + binaryStr;
        int result = 0;
        boolean flip = true;
        for (int index = 0; index < h; index++) {
            if (binaryStr.charAt(index) == (flip ? '1' : '0')) {
                result += Math.pow(2, h - index);
            } else {
                flip = !flip;
                result += 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(result);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
